verdict_rationale: The authors' R post-processing of the archived OxCal output reproduces exactly: all 54 cells of Supplement Tables 2-10, every supplement section 10 text value, the main-text ancestor inferences (T05, T07, T08) and the 54-relation summary, the Fig 4 tempo plots in content, and the section 11/12 lattice values through R1 aids. Two analyses could not be reproduced: paper Fig 3 (the authors' section 4 code fails on the published data, a code-data mismatch) and the five-run replicability analysis (Supplement Table 1 and its summary; four of five MCMC runs unavailable). One main-text value (T06, 0.87) is a suspected paper error that leaves the conclusion intact. Coverage 25/34. With two substantive analyses not reproducible, PARTIAL rather than SUCCESSFUL. OxCal regeneration is out of scope (attempt-03).

targets.notes: R1 verification aid: allen_illustrate('branching'|'transformation'|'reticulation'|'branch'|'transform'|'reticulate') (ArchaeoPhases 1.8). All 78 relation memberships (13 x 6 lattices) equal the opaque labels of paper Fig 2 (read from a 300 dpi render) and the section 3 text sets. Titles and styling not scored, per plan.

targets.failure_mode: Authors' code fails on the published data: burial.dates <- c(3:5, 7, 9, 12:78) indexes column 78, but read_oxcal() (ArchaeoPhases 1.8) returns 77 columns, so occurrence_plot() stops with 'undefined columns selected'. The code's x_min=500/x_max=700 also disagree with the published 400-800 axis: the published figure was not made from the published code + data as given (code-data mismatch).
targets.notes: Authors' section 4 code run verbatim (path-only edits) on the published beads-1.csv. Not corrected: changing the index vector would change the data selection (invariant 2). Surfaced for human confirmation.

outputs/test-bead-tempos.pdf (authors' section 6 code) compared panel by panel with paper Fig 4 (200 dpi render): same 23 panels in the same order and same mean/credible-interval curve shapes. The text's early versus late classes separate cleanly (median event year <= 590 for every early type; >= 626 for every late type). BE1-Disc first event 665, last 756 (later 7th to mid 8th c.). The only difference is the ggplot2 theme (grey panel background versus published white): a style difference from an unpublished convention, which the plan pre-classes as MINOR_DISCREPANCY.

All 8 depicted links are supported by the reproduced probabilities: CylRound(oFD) Orange 0.95, SegGlob 1.00, WoundSp 0.96, Dghnt 0.99; Amber(oFDm)Dghnt 1; Amber(oFD) Cowrie 1, Amethyst 1; Cowrie(oFD)Disc 1.00. Placements (comparisons/values/T04-fig-6-placements.csv; illustration-box positions measured on a 400 dpi render) agree in relative order with the reproduced tempo first/last event years. Largest endpoint differences (years): Disc lower box 47, Cowrie upper 42, Amethyst upper 41, WoundSp upper 34, Orange 33 (both ends), Dghnt upper 28; all others within 20: within a few decades, so MINOR_DISCREPANCY per the plan. Hand-composed figure; illustrations not scored.
Section 7 matrix: BE3-Amber(oFD)BE1-Amethyst = 1 and BE3-Amber(oFD)BE1-Cowrie = 1 exactly ('always satisfies'); converse cells 0, confirming row = ancestor orientation.

Published BE1-Cowrie(oFD)BE1-Disc = 0.87; reproduced 0.99967 (2 dp 1.00) from the authors' section 7 code. The published 0.87 equals a different cell of the same matrix, BE1-Amethyst(oFD)BE1-Disc = 0.86717 (comparisons/values/T06-section-07-full-matrix.csv), consistent with a misread row. Verification: the same inputs and code reproduce all 54 tabulated values of Supplement Tables 2-10 exactly, including R-rounding edge cases (0.065 -> 0.06). Orientation confirmed by T05. The paper's qualitative claim (Disc most likely descended from Cowrie) holds and is stronger (1.00 > Amethyst 0.87 > Amber 0.83). SUSPECTED: escalated for human confirmation. Residual alternative: a different, unpublished MCMC run.

Section 8 (oFD): CylRound is the unique argmax ancestor for Orange (0.950 vs CylPen 0.924, Melon 0.842, SegGlob 0.507), WoundSp (0.959 vs 0.875, 0.365, 0.835) and Dghnt (0.992 vs 0.946, 0.440, 0.908).
Section 9 (oFDm): BE3-Amber -> BE1-Dghnt = 1.000; Amethyst 0.132, Cowrie 0.271, Disc 0.001. Argmax = BE3-Amber.

54 relations reproduced (all equal to the published tables at 2 dp). (a) Typically low: median 0.375; 20 of 54 <= 0.10 (identical to published). (b) 12 relations > 0.9, all involve BE1-Disc (identical to published).

escalations.detail: Paper p.16 l.374-376 reports BE1-Cowrie(oFD)BE1-Disc = 0.87; the authors' own section 7 code on the published beads-1.csv gives 0.99967 (1.00). 0.87 is the BE1-Amethyst(oFD)BE1-Disc cell (0.86717) of the same matrix. All 54 Supplement Table 2-10 values reproduce exactly from the same inputs, so the pipeline matches the authors'. Conclusion unaffected. Needs human confirmation before entering study data.
